projectDescription: Community-reverse-engineered documentation for Discord's undocumented bot Display Name Styles API, covering fonts, effects, and colors per guild.
keyFeatures: Set per-guild bot display name font via display_name_font_id
Set per-guild bot display name effect via display_name_effect_id
Set per-guild bot display name colors (decimal RGB) via display_name_colors
Clear all display name styles by patching null values
12 confirmed font IDs (gg sans through Journal)
Gradient support with up to 5 color stops
